messages:
elaine_sales: Quick sync on AcmeHealth POC — they asked for SOC2 artifacts + pen-test attestation and want to run an on‑prem UAT. Timeline is tight (need evidence by 2024-11-15). Can SE + Compliance confirm what we can share?

jordan_se: @marta_compliance FYI. For on‑prem UAT we'll need to confirm networking approach: VPC peering vs temporary VPN. Also will they need staging creds or SSO metadata?

marta_compliance: We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II summary and our ISO27001 scope document. We do not share raw audit logs or vendor internal findings. Pen‑test attestation letter is doable but requires legal sign‑off — typically 2 business days after draft finalization.

customer_james: Hi team — Acme's ask list: 1) SOC2 summary, 2) pen‑test attestation letter addressed to Acme naming them as the POC customer, 3) short staging network diagram, 4) confirmation of creds method. Procurement also wants written pricing delta for any dedicated staging/networking costs.

jordan_se: SAML metadata isn't required for initial functional UAT; we can supply ephemeral test users and a demo SSO flow. Networking options for staging:
- Option A: temporary SSH bastion with static egress IPs (fast)
- Option B: VPC peering (higher security, needs infra ticket + 3–5 business days)
Which does Acme prefer?

elaine_sales: Need to surface pricing quickly. @ops_bot can you paste the short quote for dedicated staging IPs and one‑time VPN setup? We'll include pro‑rated burst pricing for a 2‑week window.

ops_bot: Quick quote snippet: Dedicated staging static IPs = $1,200/month. One‑time VPN/peering setup = $1,000. Short‑term burst capacity (2 weeks) = pro‑rated $600. Shipping as line items in amendment is recommended.

marta_compliance: Internal checklist for evidence pack: 
- Redacted SOC2 Type II summary + control mapping (redact customer identifiers)
- ISO27001 scope PDF
- Pen‑test attestation (signed, high‑level findings redacted)
- Network diagram (staging only)
- Evidence‑handling attestation for the receiving party (one paragraph)
If Acme requests the full pen‑test report we require a signed NDA and legal review.

customer_james: They prefer SFTP but said presigned S3 is acceptable if link expiry and ACLs are in place. 7‑day expiry is fine. Also procurement flagged: "show monthly delta for staging IPs + one‑time setup" in the quote.

jordan_se: We'll do a presigned S3 bundle with 7‑day expiry. @marta_compliance confirm redaction level: no customer PII, no raw log lines, remove internal IP allocations?

marta_compliance: Confirmed — remove customer PII and internal IPs. Keep control descriptions and summary evidence. Also require the evidence‑handling attestation signed by Acme before we upload the full pack.

elaine_sales: Action items (recap):
1) @marta_compliance draft redacted evidence pack and pen‑test attestation by 2024‑11‑10.
2) @ops_bot generate presigned S3 URL (7d expiry) once pack is ready.
3) @jordan_se coordinate with Acme (customer_james) to pick networking option and confirm whether they want SFTP instead.
4) Elaine to issue pricing amendment for dedicated staging IPs and one‑time setup by EOD.

customer_james: Sounds good. One more ask: who signs the pen‑test attestation on your side? Need official signatory name for procurement.

marta_compliance: Legal will sign. I'll loop in Legal (cc procurement) and confirm signatory name — expect name within 48 hours after draft.

jordan_se: For UAT creds we'll create ephemeral test accounts and an API key with read‑only scope; keys auto‑expire after 14 days. I'll provide a short snippet for how to call the read‑only endpoint:
```curl
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY_READONLY" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/status
```

customer_james: Great — that works for security. Any other blockers?

marta_compliance: Only potential blocker is if Acme insists on the raw pen‑test report; that triggers NDA + extended legal review. Otherwise we're clear.

elaine_sales: Perfect — I'll consolidate into a short email and send the amendment + timeline after legal chimes in. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
